verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a custom report builder that filters or groups by class, location, or tag dimensions. The reporting evidence covers only standard P&L, balance sheet and cash flow reports with month-to-month or year-to-year comparisons. The homepage line "Tag it, track it" is a vague marketing reference to tagging and says nothing about building dimensional reports, so it is at most an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can build custom reports filtered and grouped by class, location, or tag dimensions
